newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cemig share sale seen in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cemig share sale seen in Q1.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank is likely to sell a 33 percent minority stake in Minas Gerais power company Cemig in the first quarter of the year, a Cemig official said.
"We are only waiting for Brazil's National Development Bank and Minas Gerais state to finish drawing up a plan to auction the minority stake," said the official, who asked not to be named.
Under the plan, BNDES will sell a 33 percent stake in Cemig to a strategic partner at auction, he said.
Many foreign power firms have been visiting Cemig in the last few months to assess the firm and get more information about the company, the official said.
Among the companies most interested in acquiring a stake in Cemig are U.S. Southern Electric Power Co Ltd and Chile's Chilectra SA, he added.
